spanish: Y era como entrar Moisés a la tienda, descendía columna de la nube, y se paraba abertura de la tienda, y hablaba con Moisés.

findings.issue: The construct noun is the place of the qal 3ms standing; Spanish juxtaposes se paraba with abertura and does not mark that place-role, and pararse can also be read as halting.

notes: Remaining tokens match: habitual היה + כ + infinitive, directional tent, imperfect descend, construct pillar of the cloud, and piel speech with Moses.
